name: Cheque 19
definition: Characteristics of a cheque instruction, such as cheque type or cheque number.

ChequeType.name: Cheque Type
ChequeType.definition: Specifies the type of cheque to be issued.

ChequeNumber.name: Cheque Number
ChequeNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a cheque as assigned by the agent.

ChequeFrom.name: Cheque From
ChequeFrom.definition: Identifies the party that ordered the issuance of the cheque.

DeliveryMethod.name: Delivery Method
DeliveryMethod.definition: Specifies the delivery method of the cheque by the debtor's agent.

DeliverTo.name: Deliver To
DeliverTo.definition: Party to whom the debtor's agent needs to send the cheque.

InstructionPriority.name: Instruction Priority
InstructionPriority.definition: Urgency or order of importance that the originator would like the recipient of the payment instruction to apply to the processing of the payment instruction.

ChequeMaturityDate.name: Cheque Maturity Date
ChequeMaturityDate.definition: Date when the draft becomes payable and the debtor's account is debited.

FormsCode.name: Forms Code
FormsCode.definition: Identifies, in a coded form, the cheque layout, company logo and digitised signature to be used to print the cheque, as agreed between the initiating party and the debtor's agent.

MemoField.name: Memo Field
MemoField.definition: Information that needs to be printed on a cheque, used by the payer to add miscellaneous information.

RegionalClearingZone.name: Regional Clearing Zone
RegionalClearingZone.definition: Regional area in which the cheque can be cleared, when a country has no nation-wide cheque clearing organisation.

PrintLocation.name: Print Location
PrintLocation.definition: Specifies the print location of the cheque.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.definition: Signature to be used by the cheque servicer on a specific cheque to be printed.

ChequeMaturityDateRule.definition: If ChequeMaturityDate is present, then ChequeType must be present and equal to DRFT or ELDR.
